# T027 UART TX serializer and sending-side MMIO

Prepared November6 from clean a04e23a T026 commit; sole activeT027, no attempts.
Baseline evidence/prepare/T027-baseline-2026-11-06.json records1075 existing source
hashes. Existing UART RTL/tests absent before edits. No original file removed,
CPU/ARCH/XPR/map/reset priorities/clock/target changed. New uart_tx.sv and
uart_mmio_tx.sv implement868cycles/bit at100MHz,8N1LSBfirst/idlehigh, accepted data
capture, complete current frame on disable and synchronous reset abort. One local
unanswered request, registered response, held snapshots and no consume-edge
replacement. TX launches only at successful response acceptance, not request
acceptance. Busy selected-low writes stall; disabled TXDATA writes error. Natural
lanes, partialCTRL/reserved/RO/unallocated accesses follow approved UART map.
RX data/flags remain empty/0 until mandatoryT042, CTRL RXenable stored; no receiver,
SoC hookup, compiled UART firmware or physical operation claimed.

Independent timestamp/queue model and SV pre/post comparisons cover both direct
PHY and MMIO. Eight reference/policy tests PASS. Prepared seeds1/20261106 at
dividers4/868 produce11733/11944/112097/94718 rows,230492 total; fast variant completes
all256 payloads through both interfaces. Required scenarios include long response
stalls/no early effects, request busy holds, status snapshot while busy finishes,
enable/disable, lanes/reserved/RO/invalid maps, pending/active/offered reset and
no replacement at response-consume edge. Actual XSim/wave/negative results pending;
wrong-expected/empty/truncated controls require exact diagnostics. New test-uart
and generic synthesis lint retain all previous21 regression targets, total22.
No old check, negative, timeout or attempt policy weakened.

Commands: python -B dv/unit/test_uart.py(exit0,8tests); next python -B scripts/harness.py
finish T027 --evidence evidence/daily/T027.md, attempt1/3. Versions unchanged:
Python3.9.13/Git2.48.1.windows.1/tzdata2026.2/Vivado-XSim2025.2 SW6299465. No install,
download/globalPATH/push/scheduler/programming. Runtime unrestricted/never and
attendedonly, not a sandbox. Exactlyexisting November6reportpair before finish.
On pass audit actual source/summary/vector/WDB/tool bindings and historical files,
reviewdiff/whitespace, commit inspected files, thenquery actualnext(expectedT042).
No formal(T023skipped/NOT RUN), full22regression, RX/IRQ/SoC/CDC/routedtiming/hardware/
ASIC signoff. Preserve every failure and source archive before any correction.
